description: Glowmere over four times the ground: every weight is glowmere-medium's, so the per-square-metre density and the proportions between the species are unchanged, and the extent is doubled to 840 m. The mid and background view distances are fixed in metres, so a larger world puts more of itself inside them -- this is the rung that dials the geometry the scene pass pays for without touching the art direction. The terrain grows with it: 441 chunks against medium's 121.
